**Moving a prescription to Publix**
Atorvastatin Calcium — 30 × 10mg Tablet — Publix: $30.15 with the card, observed 2026-09-20
1. Call or visit the pharmacy you want to use — or open its app — and say you want to transfer a prescription.
2. Give your name and date of birth, the medicine and its strength, and the name and phone number of the pharmacy that has the prescription now (both are on the label).
3. The new pharmacy contacts the old one for you. It can take from a few hours to a couple of business days; ask when it will be ready.
4. At pickup, show the FineRx card and ask for the price with it before you pay.
- Transferring a prescription is free.
- If no refills are left, the pharmacy needs a new prescription from your prescriber instead.
- Some medicines — controlled ones especially — have stricter transfer rules; the pharmacist will tell you.
- Publix, 601 Northwest 2nd Avenue, Miami — 0.1 mi
- Publix, 1776 Biscayne Boulevard, Miami — 1.1 mi

**Free FineRx card:** BIN 610219 · PCN DRX · Group MYCARD3993
Use the free FineRx card — accepted at 34+ pharmacy chains, no signup. Save it, print it, email or text it. Savings with the card can be substantial: estimated price with the card is $30.15 (observed 2026-09-20), more on our site. Show the card at the pharmacy to get the final price.
